subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicitly configured `gateway.bind="tailnet"` fail startup whenever the Tailnet IPv4 is unavailable, or intentionally retain local loopback availability?
rationale: Strict failure honors the documented Tailnet-only contract, while the existing fallback preserves local availability during Tailscale outages and may be relied upon by current operators.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
options.body: Reject startup with an actionable error when `tailnet` cannot resolve, while leaving `auto` loopback fallback unchanged.

options.title: Keep degraded local startup
options.body: Retain loopback fallback but emit a prominent warning and degraded readiness/status signal so operators cannot mistake it for active Tailnet reachability.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
recommendation.body: Reject startup with an actionable error when `tailnet` cannot resolve, while leaving `auto` loopback fallback unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline explicitly routed this gateway startup-policy decision to steipete, and the choice affects documented behavior and operator compatibility.
